zh-CN.title: 小票气泡更加轻巧
items: 压缩票号与条码区域，短消息不再被上下装饰过度拉高
语音、文件、位置、足迹和链接卡片采用更紧凑的小票排版
锯齿边、票号、分隔线和条码仍完整保留

en.title: A lighter receipt bubble
items: The serial and barcode strips are slimmer, so short messages no longer feel vertically stretched
Audio, file, location, travel map, and link cards now use a more compact receipt layout
Perforated edges, serial line, separators, and barcode remain intact
